name: ssh_harvest
author: jm33-ng
comment: Capture clear-text SSH credentials with an eBPF uprobe on the sshd authentication path (no ptrace, no breakpoints)
help: Capture clear-text SSH credentials with an eBPF uprobe on the sshd authentication path, without ptrace or breakpoints. The default probe watches sshd's password store on x86_64; override reg-name, code-pattern, path, or pid for a different build or process. timeout stops the capture automatically; disable stops it and reports the credentials collected so far. The agent must hold CAP_BPF/CAP_PERFMON and CAP_SYS_ADMIN or equivalent.

parameters.name: reg-name
parameters.description: Register that holds the password at the probe point (x86_64: RAX, RDI, RSI, RDX, RCX, R8, R9, RBP, RSP, RBX, R12-R15)

parameters.name: code-pattern
parameters.description: Hex byte pattern marking where sshd stores the password; empty uses the built-in default

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description: Seconds before the capture stops itself; empty or 0 keeps it running until `--disable`

parameters.name: pid
parameters.description: Attach only to this PID (-1 probes every process mapping the binary)

parameters.name: disable
parameters.description: Stop the running capture, report the credentials it collected, and remove it
